source: proofs/lem-extcb-corner-dimension-additivity (af-validated, taint clean). FULL VALIDATED CONTRACT: Level-one corner-dimension additivity: for two finite-dimensional commutative C*-algebras with projection bases and non-unital sufficiently accurate inclusions v,w, the compressed corner S_{v(I),w(I)} is linearly bijective to the direct sum over j,k of S_{v(Pi_j),w(Sigma_k)}.
